sheets.name: Read me
sheets.title: Microsoft Intune for Government - Discovery Pack
sheets.subtitle: Information gathering for the High Level Design. No design decisions, no solution content.
rows: Gather every input needed to write the High Level Design. This pack is for information gathering only - it contains no design decisions and no solution content.

'Discovery register' is the master list of questions. The other tabs are inventory templates and trackers that the register points to. 'Dashboard' counts progress. 'Sources' records every reference used and how current it is.

Work the register domain by domain. For each row: agree who owns the answer, gather it by the method in 'How to obtain', record the answer and a link to the evidence, then set Status. Anything still Open when discovery closes becomes an assumption or an open issue in the HLD.
Shaded cells are for you to complete. Grey italic rows are worked examples showing the expected format - delete them before use.
Every register row names the HLD section it feeds, so you can see what is still missing before writing starts, and nothing is gathered that no section needs.
Rows shaded orange mark a capability that is absent or restricted in GCC High / DoD. Confirm each one against the Microsoft government service description before the design assumes it.
Some answers need observation, not a workshop. Start the elevation audit and any application usage telemetry in week one, or they become the critical path.
Intune changes monthly. Re-check the 'Sources' tab dates before relying on any feature statement; the government feature tables in particular move.
The dashboard counts are formulas. They populate when the workbook is opened in a spreadsheet application.

Built 2026-09-30, rebuilt through the discovery-creator skill 2026-09-30. Structure follows the Microsoft Intune planning guide (7 steps) and the Microsoft 'IDPDIG - Table templates' download; see 'Sources'.
The spec beside this file is the source of truth. Update the pack with: /discovery-creator Microsoft Intune government --refresh microsoft-intune-government-discovery-pack.xlsx
When every Must-priority row is answered or owned: /hld-creator Microsoft Intune government --skeleton, then the full run.
Master question list: 169 questions across 17 domains, each traced to an HLD section.
Per-cohort device inventory: counts, OS, join state, enrolment, Windows 11 readiness.
GPO inventory and translation tracker for Group Policy analytics output.
Configuration Manager estate and co-management workload assessment.
Tenants, directory sync, Conditional Access, group and RBAC structure.
Sites, proxy and TLS inspection, endpoint allow-listing, certificate infrastructure.
Current and target baselines mapped to CIS, STIG, NCSC and Essential Eight.
Environment, classification, accreditation route and the GCC High / DoD feature gap check.
Persona catalogue with apps, data classification and device needs.
Entitlements held against entitlements each capability requires.
Ring and pilot structure, and the deployment-plan constraints in public preview.
Every data-collection tool, what it gathers, permissions needed and its caveats.
Nine workshops: attendees, duration, inputs, outputs and the register rows each closes.
Risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and the decisions discovery must surface.
Every source used, with publication and access dates, and the comment-section assessment.
Progress by domain and by status.
